name: Shanmugasundaram Selvam
profile: Long-time non-executive, non-independent director of Sun TV Network (on the board from 10 Aug 2009) and a major shareholder (67.7 lakh shares). Died suddenly on 10 October 2024, per Sun TV's FY2024-25 annual report.
notes: Deceased 10 Oct 2024. Source: Sun TV Network Annual Report 2024-25 (NSE), https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/SUNTV1_28082025163743_Annual_Report_2024-25.pdf
